mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 9.0% signal economic distress and reduced consumer spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through earnings contraction and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (<=0.2%) and high unemployment (>=9.0%) indicate monetary policy ineffectiveness in a liquidity trap, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to persistent economic weakness.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 450) and GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11300) indicate post-recession recovery momentum, driving positive S&P 500 60-day returns through sustained consumer spending and corporate investment.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates robust manufacturing output supporting corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through improved profit margins.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 450) combined with low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) indicate synchronized demand stimulus and monetary support, producing positive S&P 500 20-day returns through consumer spending acceleration.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls exceeding 132,000 thousand signal labor market strengthening, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through sustained household income growth.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 132000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02.
